text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer has ended. To sum it up, I would say…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! It was the Summer of the Overlord's Awakening!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa… Our dealings were very much worth my time.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thanks to her, I have been freed from the cursed burden of overwhelming victory.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I no longer fear chaos and disorder!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I will sift through the dirt and grime so that I may find a truly beautiful gemstone hidden beneath.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Be I the hunter or the hunted, I will stride boldly down the center of my path and rout those who challenge me. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The way forward is revealed. From here on, T.M. Opera O will assert not only her brilliance…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She'll walk the path of dominance as the Overlord, with beauty and strength to match her pride.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am no longer the Overlord in the simplest sense. No…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I want to be an overlord who thrives on the razor's edge! A narrow margin will suffice for it is my friend!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer. I require a new title.
choice_data_list: Oh! Uh, sure. Um, uhh… The Edgelord?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaa ha ha! Indeed, for I do always stand at the precipice!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The thrill of knowing a single misstep will send me tumbling…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I cannot help but feel a more appropriate title remains out there…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes—in the Japan Cup, I shall demonstrate to all that I'm the Overlord of Ultimate Power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Opera O turns her back and struts away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In that moment, I could swear the word "Centurial" had appeared across her back.
